messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-09] standup/dune/2025-01-09: Farah runs team Dune solo until the next hire lands.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14: Rotation day for the Dune team: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2026-01-16] standup/dune/2026-01-16: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for team Dune starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-3: Release captain for Q3 2025: Farah.
- [2025-11-17] standup/dune/2025-11-17: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2026-02-11] handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags: The Ember team handed the flags service to the Dune team today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah.
- [2025-10-15] standup/dune/2025-10-15: Farah has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Tomasz Nowak.
- [2026-03-11] standup/dune/2026-03-11: Tomasz has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Farah.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-scheduler: Handover: as of today scheduler moves from the Ember team to the Dune team. Oskar walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-12-10] standup/dune/2025-12-10: Tomasz Nowak has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Farah.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-09-04] standup/dune/2025-09-04: Tomasz Nowak picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-07-30] standup/atlas/2025-07-30: Team change: Tomasz leaves team Atlas and joins team Dune, effective today. On-call for Atlas passes from Tomasz to Priya with the move.
- [2025-11-06] handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags: Quick one: feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to team Atlas for running it until now.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20: Marcus moves from team Boreal to the Atlas team today. On-call for Boreal passes from Marcus to Lena with the move.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-10] standup/ember/2025-01-10: The Ember team is a one-person team at the moment: Oskar.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-07] standup/boreal/2025-01-07: Lena and Marcus make up the Boreal team.
- [2025-07-24] standup/dune/2025-07-24: The Dune team sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-04-03] standup/atlas/2025-04-03: Reminder from team Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-11-27] standup/cinder/2025-11-27: As of today Diego Alvarez is on the Ember team; Cinder loses a pair of hands. Yuki takes the Cinder pager from Diego, who is leaving the team.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06-2: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-06-19] standup/atlas/2025-06-19: Rotation day for team Atlas: Priya hands the pager to Tomasz.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-09-23] standup/boreal/2025-09-23: Reminder from team Boreal: page Lena for anything this cycle, not Marcus.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: The Atlas team this year is Priya Raman and Tomasz.

Question: Which team is Farah on?

message.reasoning:
The question: Which team is Farah on?

Memory entries about Farah: She runs team Dune solo, on-call rotation for Dune team, Dune pager, etc. So Farah is on team Dune.
